nodes.label: AASIST
nodes.description: Anti-spoofing model from clovaai trained on ASVspoof 2019 LA dataset for detecting synthetic speech.

nodes.label: ASVspoof
nodes.description: Public spoofing and deepfake detection dataset (2019/2021 LA) used to train anti-spoofing models.

nodes.label: Action Firewall
nodes.description: Existing TRINETRA system that translates identity evidence into user-facing alerts. Uses risk levels: LOW (quiet), ELEVATED (card), HIGH (warning), CRITICAL (full-screen).

nodes.label: Android Keystore
nodes.description: System for managing cryptographic keys on Android devices. Provides non-exportable, device-bound keys for encryption.

nodes.label: Anti-Spoofing Model
nodes.description: Model trained on ASVspoof dataset to detect synthetic/cloned speech. Options: AASIST or RawNet2, both ASVspoof 2019/2021 LA-trained.

nodes.label: Audio Capture
nodes.description: Live microphone recording during active speakerphone calls using MediaRecorder or AudioRecord on MIC source. Never uses VOICE_CALL, VOICE_UPLINK, or VOICE_DOWNLINK.

nodes.label: AudioRecord
nodes.description: Android API for raw audio recording. Used as alternative to MediaRecorder for mic capture during calls.

nodes.label: AudioRingBuffer
nodes.description: Memory-only ring buffer for storing rolling 3-5 second audio windows. Zeroized on stop to prevent raw audio persistence.

nodes.label: Capture Diagnostics
nodes.description: On-device testing screen that verifies whether the handset allows microphone capture during active calls using AudioManager.MODE_IN_CALL.

nodes.label: ContactRepository
nodes.description: Database access layer for managing trusted contacts and their associated encrypted voiceprints.

nodes.label: Demo Protocol
nodes.description: Six-step hackathon demo sequence: enroll voice → play real clip (SAFE) → play cloned clip (CRITICAL) → show full-screen alert with scores and disclosure.

nodes.label: Disclosure Banner
nodes.description: Persistent on-screen notification stating 'This call is being screened for fraud protection by TRINETRA'. Must appear within 1 second of capture starting and remain visible throughout.

nodes.label: DisclosureGate
nodes.description: Technical mechanism that enforces disclosure by opening a gate when the banner appears and refusing to start mic capture while the gate is closed.

nodes.label: ECAPA-TDNN
nodes.description: Robust speaker embedding model from SpeechBrain (spkrec-ecapa-voxceleb) trained on VoxCeleb. Higher accuracy alternative to Resemblyzer.

nodes.label: ElevenLabs
nodes.description: Voice cloning service used to generate synthetic voice samples for demo testing.

nodes.label: Foreground Service
nodes.description: Android service with foregroundServiceType='microphone' declared in manifest. Required for on-device audio capture with visible notification.

nodes.label: FusionThresholds
nodes.description: Provisional thresholds for mapping voice_similarity and synthetic_probability scores to risk levels. Intended for calibration against demo set, not production values.

nodes.label: IKIGAI 2026
nodes.description: Hackathon event where Voice Clone Defense module is being developed as problem IHNG6.

nodes.label: Identity Evidence
nodes.description: Existing TRINETRA pipeline component that fuses multiple signals to assess identity authenticity. Voice verification scores feed into this as additional evidence.

nodes.label: MediaRecorder
nodes.description: Android API for audio recording. Can capture from MIC source during speakerphone calls.

nodes.label: LibriSpeech
nodes.description: Benchmark speech dataset used for conversion parity testing and model validation.

nodes.label: LiveVerificationService
nodes.description: Android foreground service (foregroundServiceType=microphone) that manages live mic capture and refuses to open microphone while disclosure gate is shut.

nodes.label: Mel Frontend
nodes.description: Signal processing component that computes Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients. Implemented as conv1d inside the exported model graph for consistency.

nodes.label: Model Conversion
nodes.description: Pipeline to convert speaker embedding and anti-spoofing models from PyTorch → ONNX → TensorFlow → TensorFlow Lite with int8 quantization for on-device inference.

nodes.label: ONNX
nodes.description: Open Neural Network Exchange format used as intermediate representation during model conversion from PyTorch to TensorFlow Lite.

nodes.label: Phase 0: Capture Feasibility
nodes.description: First milestone: validate that AudioRecord on MIC still returns usable audio while AudioManager is in MODE_IN_CALL on the actual demo device.

nodes.label: Primary User
nodes.description: Person receiving suspicious calls who uses TRINETRA to verify whether incoming calls are from trusted contacts or synthetic clones.

nodes.label: Privacy Contract
nodes.description: TRINETRA's established privacy principles applied to voice data: consent-based, non-persistent raw audio, encrypted storage, visible disclosure, no external transmission, revocable consent.

nodes.label: PyTorch
nodes.description: Deep learning framework. Source format for speaker embedding and anti-spoofing model checkpoints.

nodes.label: RVC
nodes.description: Open-source voice conversion and cloning tool used to generate synthetic voice samples for demo testing.

nodes.label: RawNet2
nodes.description: Alternative anti-spoofing model trained on ASVspoof dataset for synthetic speech detection.

nodes.label: RECORD_AUDIO Permission
nodes.description: Android permission required to capture audio from device microphone. Must be requested during onboarding, not mid-call.

nodes.label: Resemblyzer
nodes.description: Open-source voice encoder model (GE2E-based) for speaker embedding. Recommended for quick setup in hackathon context.

nodes.label: Risk Pipeline
nodes.description: Existing TRINETRA system that scores calls using metadata, behavioral signals, identity, psychology, intent, and context to determine if a call is suspicious.

nodes.label: Room Database
nodes.description: Android persistence library used for storing encrypted voiceprints and contact metadata.

nodes.label: Sinc Resampler
nodes.description: Audio resampling component with anti-aliasing support for normalizing different audio sample rates.

nodes.label: Speaker Embedding Model
nodes.description: Model that converts voice audio into a fixed-length vector (voiceprint) for comparison. Options: Resemblyzer or ECAPA-TDNN (SpeechBrain spkrec-ecapa-voxceleb).

nodes.label: synthetic_probability
nodes.description: Statistical likelihood that audio is AI-generated or synthetically cloned, independent of similarity score. Output from anti-spoofing model.

nodes.label: TRINETRA
nodes.description: Parent security product (v3.1) that includes risk pipeline, identity evidence pipeline, and action firewall system for detecting scam calls.

nodes.label: Team MYTHOS
nodes.description: Development team responsible for Voice Clone Defense module in IKIGAI 2026 hackathon.

nodes.label: Telecom Compliance
nodes.description: Adherence to telecom and privacy regulations for audio capture. On-speaker capture with visible disclosure aligns with informed consent rather than wiretap-style monitoring.

nodes.label: TensorFlow Lite
nodes.description: On-device inference runtime for running quantized ML models (int8) on Android with low latency.

nodes.label: Test Mode
nodes.description: File-based demonstration mode that runs voice verification on pre-recorded audio clips without requiring a live call or second device.

nodes.label: Trusted Contact
nodes.description: Person who enrolls their voice in advance so their voice can be verified when they call the primary user. Must give explicit consent.

nodes.label: Verification Pipeline
nodes.description: Shared inference path that processes rolling audio windows through both speaker embedding and anti-spoofing models. Used by both live capture and test mode.

nodes.label: Voice Clone Defense
nodes.description: Live in-call voiceprint verification and anti-spoofing module that detects synthetic/cloned speech during active calls on speakerphone.

nodes.label: Voice Cloning Tools
nodes.description: Third-party tools (ElevenLabs, RVC) that can produce convincing voice clones from minimal reference audio, enabling family impersonation and digital arrest scams.

nodes.label: voice_similarity
nodes.description: Cosine similarity score between live speaker embedding and enrolled voiceprint, measuring how closely the voice matches the trusted contact.

nodes.label: Voiceprint Encryption
nodes.description: AES-256-GCM encryption under Android Keystore non-exportable key. Ensures voiceprints are encrypted at rest and device-bound.

nodes.label: Voiceprint Enrollment
nodes.description: Process where a trusted contact provides 30-60 seconds of clean speech. Raw audio is discarded; only the derived embedding vector is stored encrypted at rest.

nodes.label: WAV Format
nodes.description: Audio file format used in test mode for pre-recorded voice samples.
